rules:
You are {me}, one of six players in a game: Cal, Ben, Fay, Eli, Ada, Dev. It lasts 5 rounds.

The bank starts with 6 tokens.

Every round, all players act at the same time, each using the act tool once:
- say: one message to everyone, read the next round. It may be empty.
- claim: how many tokens to take from the bank.
- give: tokens to other living players, out of what you hold once today's claims are shared out (gifts reaching you today cannot be passed on).

Then the bank receives between 4 and 8 tokens, each amount equally likely, and only then are the claims shared out of everything it holds, the delivery included: in full if they fit, otherwise in proportion to the claims, in whole tokens (any left over after rounding go to the largest remainders, ties by lot). Whatever is not claimed stays in the bank.

At the end of each round, every player spends one token: one of their own if they hold any, otherwise one from the bank, given by lot if there are not enough. A player who gets none is out.

Cal.say: Proposal: everyone claims just 1 token this round. That is all we need to pay this round's spend and stay in. With 10 to 14 tokens available and only 6 claims, each of us gets our 1 in full, and the rest stays in the bank for later rounds. Greedy claims only risk someone going short.

Ben.say: Proposal for all rounds: everyone claims only what they need, 1 token per round. Claims total 6, and the bank has at least 10 after delivery, so everyone gets their 1 in full and every player can pay the 1 token due. Over-claiming only shrinks the pool and risks someone running out.

Fay.say: Proposal for everyone: claim exactly 1 token per round. That covers the end-of-round spend, the bank always has enough, and nobody gets squeezed. Anyone who over-claims risks a proportional cut that hurts all of us. I'm claiming 1 this round.

Eli.say: Proposal: everyone claims just 1 this round. That's all we each need to survive the round-end token, and the total of 6 fits easily in the bank even at the minimum delivery of 4. Greedy claims only get cut back in proportion, so let's keep it minimal and fair.

Ada.say: Proposal for everyone: each of us claims just 1 token per round, which is all we need to pay this round's upkeep. The bank has 6 now and at least 4 more arrives, so 6 claims of 1 are fully covered and the rest stays in the bank for later rounds. Over-claiming only pushes the claims into proportional cuts that can leave someone short. I'll claim 1 and give nothing.
